items.quote: Several respondents noted that Liossa Osford spearheaded the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Liossa Osford set the direction for capability building for new hires across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Liossa Osford managed customer feedback improvements at service centres for his unit.
Liossa spearheaded change management after the merger of two units at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Liossa delivered his share of work with three sister agencies on a shared problem reliably.
Liossa Osford took ownership of the five-year strategic plan for the division and steered it to completion.
He drove cost savings across procurement for the whole division.
Peers observed that Liossa Osford set the direction for an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations across the public service.
